summary: Iteration 31 — Phase 1 Local AI providers CRUD + /roadmap public page + landing page 'Built with you' section. All 8 backend pytest cases pass. All Playwright frontend checks pass. No regressions.

backend_coverage.GET /api/providers auth: returns all 5 subsystems (chat/tts/stt/image/embeddings) with enabled/base_url/api_key/model/provider_type, all defaults disabled
backend_coverage.PUT /api/providers: accepts full ProviderConfig incl. voice + comfy_workflow extras; response reflects saved values; subsequent GET matches (persisted in db.user_providers)

frontend_coverage./roadmap public: renders without auth redirect; data-testid=roadmap-root present; H1 'Built with you, not for you.' visible
frontend_coverage.roadmap buckets: shipped (9 items), building (9 items), queued (6 items) — all with data-testid=roadmap-item-<bucket>-<i>

critical_code_review_comments: providers.py docstring header lists 'Four subsystems' but the schema/router actually ships FIVE (chat/tts/stt/image/embeddings). Cosmetic doc mismatch — worth a one-line fix for future maintainers.

SubsystemConfig has image-only extras (comfy_workflow) and tts-only extras (voice) on every subsystem. Fine for now, but consider splitting per-subsystem models in Phase 2 to avoid clients thinking they can set voice on chat.
PUT replaces the whole doc via replace_one(upsert=True) — good; no partial-update surface to worry about. Confirmed persistence via a follow-up GET.
api_key stored plaintext — acceptable since keys target 127.0.0.1 and blast radius is nil (documented in the module header), but flag if any hosted endpoints get added in Phase 2.
test_credentials: Created ephemeral session via mongosh recipe from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (cleaned up in fixture teardown).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test-user + user_sessions doc, cleaned up on fixture teardown along with any user_providers rows created during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 will actually route chat/tts/stt/image via desktop to local endpoints. CRUD storage is confirmed working. When Phase 2 lands, verify the desktop reads db.user_providers on startup + when a subsystem is enabled=false the cloud default is used. PySide6 settings dialog (Local AI tab) was NOT tested — it only runs on user's PC, per E1's note.
